topic: Quaternion Reoriented Normal Mapping (RNM) vs UDN detail normal blending flattening rig
topic_zh: 四元数重定向法线贴图（RNM）对比 UDN 细节法线混合压扁失真
scope: Deterministic Barre-Brisebois & Hill (2012) Quaternion Reoriented Normal Mapping (RNM) versus naive UDN XY addition and explicit 3x3 Gram-Schmidt TBN rotation matrix construction across 17 detail normal tilt angles (theta_2 in [-24, +40] deg on macro tilt theta_1 = 42 deg). No neural texture synthesis execution.

timing_note: Median of 7 alternating Node CPU runs after warmup. 6-operation algebraic Quaternion RNM formula versus explicit 3×3 axis-angle TBN rotation matrix construction and normalization.

protocol.function: t = n₁ + (0,0,1), u = (−n₂.xy, n₂.z), n_RNM = t·(t·u)/t.z − u → θ_RNM ≡ θ₁ + θ₂ (0.00° Error)

robustness.name: Sampled 17 detail tilt angles preserve exact geodesic normal rotation (0.00° error) without UDN flattening

good_fit: Detail normal map blending (skin pores, micro-scratches, terrain rock detail, water ripple overlays) in UE5, Unity HDRP, and Three.js
Explaining why naive UDN XY addition flattens combined normals by −15.79° at 74° and up to −21.53° at 82°
Rotating tangent-space detail normal n₂ onto macro base normal n₁ in 6 ALU ops without trigonometric calls or 3×3 matrices
Preserving unit normal length automatically when both input normals are unit vectors
not_for: Single-layer normal mapped meshes without secondary detail normal overlays
Heightfield bump addition where raw scalar heights h₁(u,v) + h₂(u,v) are summed prior to finite differencing
Neural texture synthesis or diffusion normal map generation models
Unlit flat-shaded polygons without normal mapping
